name: Wildfire Awakener
oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
When this creature enters, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with "Whenever this token becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to target player."
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with "Whenever this token becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to target player."

needs.what: a 1/1 red Elemental creature token with "Whenever this token becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to target player." (e.g. elemental_1_1_r_tapped_ping): a self becomes_tapped trigger whose effect is damage 1 from the token to a target player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has elemental_1_1_r (a vanilla 1/1 red Elemental) and elemental_1_1_r_haste, but no Elemental carrying the becomes-tapped damage trigger; giving elemental_1_1_r the trigger with a permanent grant_ability after creation would make the ability a granted effect rather than a copiable printed characteristic of the token, which is not the printed card. Convoke itself is expressible as card-level pay_generic_with "tap_creatures", and X is fine as the token amount
